status: Conditional hand-wrench study; not a physical strength, comfort, aim or performance rating

inputs.status: Explicit scenario assumptions; no measured mass, COM, load, comfort or capacity
inputs.coordinates: mm; X horizontal, Y up, Z rearward; positive Cx follows right hand rule
inputs.load_point_status: Retained prior load-analysis assumption. Separate usage motion study is 0..60 mm and is not replaced by this load point.
inputs.sensitivity_status: Analyst-chosen plausible comparisons, not measured uncertainty distributions or bounds
inputs.angle_definition: In Y/Z plane; positive angle gives upward Fy, positive Fz is rearward pull on cannon

selected_geometry.name: same_height_0
selected_geometry.status: Retained original source grip; rear30/down20 native handle is an optional comparison

closer_axis_grasp.status: Not a proposed geometry: no higher grasp is analyzed until hand clearance is demonstrated
closer_axis_grasp.conditional_algebra_only: At fixed Z, a +1 mm Y change gives delta Cx = Fz/1000 N m; at axial20N this reduces negative signed couple magnitude by0.020 N m only if it stays negative.

equations.external: F = sum(F_i); M_0 = sum(r_i cross F_i)
equations.hand: F_h=-F; C_h(H)=-sum((r_i-H) cross F_i)=-M_0+H cross F
equations.relocation: delta C_h = delta H cross F
equations.fixed_root: C_h+(H-J) cross F_h = -M_0+J cross F, independent of H
equations.mounts: A*q=-W_external; H is absent. Same point-stiffness hypothesis retains identical q.

prior_replay.scope: Algebraic replay only; prior scripts and files are unchanged

stock_centroid_comparison.method: Exact source volume-centroid proxy is held fixed while comparing hand points.0.6kg reference isolates COM effect; full-density reference is separately labelled. A redesigned handle changes its own COM, so these are not updated DesignC mass properties.

stock_with_optional_handle_only.scope: Stock17 geometry with handle4 replaced only. Excludes B/C shell/hardware changes and slice effects; uniform additive solid proxy.

interpretation_limits: Mass, COM and forces are chosen assumptions, not measured ranges or probabilities.
A lower hand couple does not by itself reduce the wrench at a fixed handle root or the retained mount group.
Redesigned section geometry, stiffness, clearance or contact can alter actual mount load sharing and local stresses.
Prior equal-point-stiffness reactions are a hypothesis, not a bound on actual sharing.
The inherited model assigns assumed body weight to the barrel-side free body; a refined split-body model must separate handle self-weight.
No grip orientation, contact pressure, finger articulation, strength, fatigue or comfort is established.
The 80mm force application offset is retained solely for continuity with prior load analysis; separate usage study covers0..60mm motion.
Geometry clearance must choose the actual grasp. Higher grips remain conditional algebra only until clearance is established.
